entities.name: Shikka
entities.description: A proud cat warrior who stays to protect her dry, gray forest.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Planar Chaos-shifted vampiric version of Mirri, cursed and malevolent, who slaughters the forest's cats.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Time-shifted renowned ancestor of the cats, followed by others who leave the forest.

entities.name: Talack
entities.description: Shikka's companion, convinced by her to stay.

entities.name: Forest of the cats
entities.description: A forest that has become dry and gray, home to Shikka.

events.summary: Shikka chooses to stay and protect the forest rather than follow Jedit, persuading Talack to stay too.
events.quote: She chose to stay, convincing her companion Talack to do the same.

events.summary: Vampiric Mirri slaughters the forest's cats; Shikka and Talack flee.
events.quote: Shikka is forced to flee for her life with Talack

events.summary: The surviving cats band together for protection.
events.quote: the surviving cats band together for protection and solace

relations.quote: convincing her companion Talack to do the same
